name: telegram-blocked-todo
description: M19 F4 acceptance: a todo that auto-blocks (burned its verify fix-cycles while its project stayed dirty) renders as BLOCKED with the [!] glyph + one-line reason on the delivered todo list, not as an in-progress step. Driven under COPPERCLAW_DATA_ROOT (like the X2 verify-gate fixture) so the in-process runner's todo store + verify gate resolve real, writable state; the parent seeds a dirty project at the fix-cycle cap + a recorded last_failure + one in_progress todo, then the model attempts todo_update(completed) which auto-transitions to blocked. Registered in tests/replay.rs via a subprocess re-exec that sets the env var (forbid(unsafe_code) blocks std::env::set_var). See README.md.
